message.meridian_villager.dummy_drill.no: Face a training post to drill
commands.meridian_villager.target.none: No training post in front of you
book.meridian_villager.sleeve_fist.note: Bare hands, whatever you hold; strike standing or in mid-air.
volume.meridian_villager.inner.note: This volume is never handed out; it is taught by the fist master in the hall
technique.meridian_villager.crushing_fis: a rear-hand punch straight to the chest that drives the foe back
technique.meridian_villager.golem_lift.n: both arms swing upward and heave the foe off the ground
technique.meridian_villager.shoulder_thr: seize the foe, turn, and heave them over the shoulder to land behind you
technique.meridian_villager.inch_power.n: a lead-hand shudder from an inch away that sinks into the organs; armor stops only half of it
technique.meridian_villager.wrist_lock.n: seize the weapon wrist and wrench it twice; the arm goes numb and the weapon drops
strike a wooden dummy, log, hay bale or dummy figure; the arms grow tireless
advancements.meridian_villager.cultivato: Beating the wooden post day and night turns arms to iron. Fists snap straight like bows, golem lifts toss men over eaves, and shoulders throw them flat on the dirt.
codex.intro.meridian_villager.sleeve_fis: An external fist handed down by village gates: springing forward like a bow, lifting men skyward like an iron golem, or tossing them over the shoulder like a sheaf of wheat.
codex.power.meridian_villager.outer: Fists snap out like bowstrings. Lift both arms to hoist a foe clean overhead, or step inside to hook their weight over your shoulder and slam them flat.
codex.power.meridian_villager.inner: A sharp burst from a mere inch away penetrates armor to strike the vitals within; twisting the wrist and pressing the elbow numbs the foe's arm, wrenching their weapon to the ground.
